scope: Shared operating instructions, memory MCP diagnostics, provider bootstrap and Claude lifecycle hooks

reviewer.interface: Claude Code CLI, tool-free source review

disposition.finding: A hybrid graph failure must not be presented as failure of persistent local memory.
disposition.resolution: Explicit ledger retry guidance, independent proposal semantics, preserved error status and no automatic downgrade. Generic failures and permission denials do not receive graph-specific diagnostics.

disposition.finding: Caller-supplied prompts and native subagents can lose the central instructions.
disposition.resolution: Merge Claude append prompts and Codex root developer instructions; add Claude SessionStart/SubagentStart context and MCP initialize instructions plus a read-only context tool. Native Codex plan and isolated-child payloads verified against a local mock provider.

disposition.finding: Reading a user prompt file into a CLI argument exposes its contents in argv/debug logs and risks argument-size limits.
disposition.resolution: Keep file-based prompts in a private temporary directory and 0600 file. Pass only the path, preserve newlines and clean up in finally. Correction independently reviewed and regression-tested.

disposition.finding: Multiple delivery paths can repeat the static operating block.
disposition.resolution: Accepted for lifecycle reliability. The composition helper deduplicates exact copies within one prompt; provider-level delivery across system prompts, hooks and MCP may repeat the block.

disposition.finding: MCP server instructions alone do not establish universal client/subagent support.
disposition.resolution: Document supported Claude/Codex paths, lifecycle handling and inherited-adapter limits. No parity or model-obedience guarantee.

independentPeerReview: Separate code review of Claude launch and lifecycle changes; confirmed private-file correction and no remaining blocking findings.

nativeLifecycleVerification.endpoint: Isolated localhost mock; no external model-provider calls
nativeLifecycleVerification.result: Passed: stored legacy thread resumed in a new process, successful native compaction, subsequent turn and isolated child all receive the full current context.
nativeLifecycleVerification.delivery: Codex preserves stored developer instructions. Current MCP initialize instructions are automatically included as the mcp__hapi namespace description in the actual model request; this is not a developer-message replacement.

deployment: Runner image rollout required. Existing running processes do not acquire new code from a repository commit; no active session was interrupted for this change.
